title: Synthetic entries: a quick look
description: Three of the entries that read no distribution, one after the other, to see that they run on this host: the kernel checks (all fifteen), a geometry sweep of the quick candidate set with one round per geometry and no idle time between cases, and the attention route bench. A quick look, not the evidence run: a sweep with one round and no cooling is no record to derive a geometry table from. The GEMV sweep is left out: its quick set measures about 2,600 kernels.
